description: What does each occupation earn per hour in a country, how many people do it, and how does that pay compare abroad?. ILOSTAT hourly earnings for the ISCO-08 major groups (local currency, USD, PPP) joined with employment by occupation: pay index vs the national average, employment share, and a PPP comparison of one occupation across up to 10 countries. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (country*, occupation, compare, limit); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
